audit.whatIsWrong: Hallowed Mist is treated as a blanket 'never burn damage into it' with no counterplay, and no cooldown appears anywhere on the page (the packet flags zero sequencing cues).
audit.why: Riot's text: she can only be targeted by enemies who enter the mist. The mist is a fixed zone — Rune Prison and Spell Flux are targeted 615-range casts, so from outside you have no target, but stepping into the mist restores it. Hallowed Mist is 22/21/20/19/18 and Skip 'n Slash is 13/12.5/12/11.5/11 with a partial refund when she hits something, so the dash comes back faster than the count suggests. Skip 'n Slash also grants attack range and applies on-hit. A Thousand Cuts heals her off champion damage, so extended trades need Grievous Wounds.
audit.corrected: Mist restated as untargetable-from-outside with the step-in counterplay, real cooldowns given, on-hit and the heal named.
